scope: Primary-source selected natural-context development cases; not an independent or sealed final test. Other uncharacterized genome anchors are ungradable, not negatives.

cases.evidence: Native purified five-subunit complex, structural sequence correspondence and coupled H2/NAD/Fd assays. HydA lacks the catalytic H-cluster; HydL is the sole NiFe catalytic subunit.
cases.limits: Fe04 is used only as a normalized molecular reaction comparator, not a FeFe catalytic-center label or a claim that the five-subunit NiFe structure is already configured. Maturation/regulatory genes are excluded from the physical core. Previously exposed structural development source.

cases.evidence: Four-gene native deletion, loss and complementation of HDCR-associated activity; published purified four-subunit HDCR and 7QV7 canonical sequence correspondence.
cases.limits: FdhD TKV_c19950 is maturation, not a core subunit. Net physiological direction and membrane anchoring are not inferred for a new homolog. Genus already exposed in FeS structural development.

cases.evidence: Four structural genes recombinantly expressed with maturation machinery; purified complex reduces NAD+ with H2. Natural MF153396 locus and full precursor translations are retained.
cases.limits: HoxW is maturation and HoxI is not a required native core member. PDB HoxH is a processed substring of the precursor; DNA annotation is not silently trimmed. 5XFA coordinate truth remains unopened for its reserved FeS evaluation; this case is L4/L5 development only.

cases.evidence: Purified native Hnd assays monitor NAD+ and FdxB reduction simultaneously under H2; reviewed Q46505..Q46508 correspond exactly to U07229 translations.
cases.limits: Historical NADP annotation is not the modern assay truth. Physiological reverse H2 production is not assigned from this assay. Genus exposed in structural development; natural locus is not a complete genome.

cases.evidence: Native WorABCSL has a W-bispyranopterin catalytic center and Bfu-like electron-transfer modules; five subunit types form the observed nanowire.
cases.limits: A reaction-scoped non-H2-center contrast, not proof of absence of all possible H2 side chemistry. The same genome contains a genuine hydrogenase: only these five members are evaluated as the contrast.

cases.evidence: Purified native electron-bifurcating NfnABC transhydrogenase, structural three-subunit identity; FAD/FMN and no hydrogenase catalytic center.
cases.limits: Mechanistic contrast, not a claim that every genome protein or every member has been individually assayed against H2. Generic NADH-dehydrogenase/molybdopterin product names do not define function.

excluded_pending_source_correspondence.reason: PDB crossrefs Q60338/Q60340/Q60341 are M. jannaschii and do not match the structural canonical sequences. Do not transfer the experimental operon to their genome.
An4 contig retrieval and correspondence to assayed DSM2662 strain remain unresolved.
Primary full text and CP002403/CP002404 obtained, but exact experimental role-to-CDS mapping still being reviewed. HydS is putative, not an experimentally established H2-sensing negative.
